description: This file declares functions and structures for OpenCDM session private data management and decryption operations, including session private data creation/destruction and decryption functions for encrypted media buffers, with support for subsample handling and metadata.

methods.name: opencdm_construct_session_private
methods.description: Creates private data for a given OpenCDMSession, returning an opaque pointer.

methods.name: opencdm_destruct_session_private
methods.description: Destroys private data associated with a given OpenCDMSession.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of media data using session and buffers, handling subsample mapping internally.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt_buffer
methods.description: Performs decryption with metadata attached to buffers, passing subsample mapping to DRM implementation.
